title: Registry Price Protection Cap Schedule for Marlowe & Finch Cardholders — Merchandise Purchases
content:
**Cap rule.** On registry price protection for a Merchandise Purchases unit, a registrant whose Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to a Marlowe & Finch card in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchases whose transaction date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reach the upper protection card-spend threshold of $3000.00 has the upper protection cap of $120.00; one whose such purchases reach the middle protection card-spend threshold of $1000.00 but not the upper has the middle protection cap of $60.00. A registrant whose such purchases total less than $1000.00 is outside this rule.

The purchases are the purchase transactions at Marlowe & Finch on the registrant's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts.

| Card purchases at Marlowe & Finch, past twelve months (hypothetical totals) | Protection cap |
|---|---|
| $3000.00 | $120.00 |
| $2999.99 | $60.00 |
| $1000.00 | $60.00 |
| $999.99 | outside this rule |
